track_a_information: (skill, successes on that skill among the last 40 completed events, failures on that skill)

track_a_pfa.name: CanonicalPFA40
track_a_pfa.formula: logit = beta_skill + gamma_success_skill * S + gamma_failure_skill * F
track_a_pfa.solver_note: Same sklearn L2 logistic objective. liblinear is the frozen solver because lbfgs overflowed and reached the 500-iteration limit on the raw counts before any confirmatory score was examined.

track_a_gru.name: CountEncodedGRU
track_a_gru.encoding: F failure tokens, then S success tokens, then one start token, all carrying the target skill
track_a_gru.updates: one Adam step per training occurrence, in cohort order, no shuffle
